sql: select 'fill' k, f.market_ticker, f.filled_at::text t, o.action||' '||o.side||' @'||o.limit_price||'c x'||f.quantity||' '||left(coalesce(o.client_order_id,''),11) v from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Alimm1' and f.filled_at > '2026-10-17 22:50' union all select 'cxl', market_ticker, created_at::text, action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,status) from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and created_at > '2026-10-17 22:50' union all select 'open', market_ticker, created_at::text, action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||status from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and status in ('resting','partial','submitted') union all select 'pos', market_ticker, captured_at::text, quantity_fp::text from (select distinct on (market_ticker) * from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) p where abs(quantity_fp)>0 and captured_at > now() - interval '1 hour' union all select 'off', component, created_at::text, message from system_events where component='limm_resting_sell_off' union all select 'now', '', now()::text, ''
